description.text: Traditional Cigar Manufacturing and Small Business Jobs Preservation Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

bill.title: Traditional Cigar Manufacturing and Small Business Jobs Preservation Act of 2026

aiDescription.summary: This bill exempts "traditional large and premium cigars" from FDA tobacco authority and forbids FDA rulemaking on them (except section 907(d)(3)). Cigars wrapped and filled with 100% leaf tobacco, no filter, tip, or non‑tobacco mouthpiece, weigh ≥6 pounds per 1,000, meet specified binder/manufacture criteria; definition excludes cigarettes and little cigars.

impact.summary: The bill exempts defined "traditional large and premium cigars" from most FDA regulation under the FD&C Act. That change would affect the FDA and the premium cigar industry, including manufacturers, importers, retailers, distributors, tobacconists, and small businesses, by removing regulatory requirements and some user fees.
